definitions.explanation: When a store has run out of a particular item and has none available. Often implies the item may be restocked later.

examples.japanese: {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません、{品切|しなぎ}れです。
その{商品|しょうひん}は{現在|げんざい}{品切|しなぎ}れ{中|ちゅう}です。
examples.english: That product is currently out of stock.

examples.japanese: {品切|しなぎ}れの{場合|ばあい}は{入荷|にゅうか}までお{待|ま}ちください。
examples.english: If it's out of stock, please wait until the next shipment arrives.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {品切|しなぎ}れ{中|ちゅう}: currently out of stock
- {品切|しなぎ}れになる: to become out of stock
- {品切|しなぎ}れの{場合|ばあい}: if out of stock

COMPARISON WITH {売|う}り{切|き}れ:
- {品切|しなぎ}れ focuses on inventory status (may be restocked)
- {売|う}り{切|き}れ focuses on sales (all were sold)

RELATED:
- {売|う}り{切|き}れ: sold out
- {在庫|ざいこ}: stock, inventory
- {入荷|にゅうか}: arrival of goods
